page.1a9e0a: The U.S. STOCK Act mandates that members of the Senate and House of Representatives and their family members disclose stock trades within 45 days. Trades by members of Congress are one of the signals market participants pay attention to in terms of access to industry and policy information. Political trading trends are used as a supplementary indicator of market sentiment, not for quantitative valuation.

page.24d5a2: Stability score is calculated based on debt-to-equity ratio and current ratio. A higher score indicates lower debt burden and excellent short-term repayment ability.
